title: Dokimos completion verification authority
description: Host-supplied authoritative expectations and independent evidence observations for one completion attempt.

ObservedAt.description: Optional. When the host observed this evidence. Required for freshness when ClaimAcquiredAt or LeaseExpiresAt is present.

Validation.description: Optional. The validation this observation proves; when present only that validation may cite it, and that validation must cite at least one evidence item bound to it.

Provenance.description: Optional (added after Dokimos 0.7.0). Where and under which content-addressed identity (dokimos.evidence-identity/1) the evidence was produced. ProducedAtRevision different from Revision means the evidence is carried forward: it must be Reusable and content-addressed. Live evidence is never reusable; per-commit evidence never crosses a commit.

Attestation.description: Optional (attested mode). The DSSE v1 envelope of an echelon.verification-receipt/1 signed by a trusted verifier. Required for evidence satisfying a required validation when TrustedVerifierKeys is non-empty; ignored otherwise. Its shape is judged semantically (DOK.COMPLETION.ATTESTATION_MALFORMED), so this schema only requires an object.

ClaimAcquiredAt.description: Optional. When the current claim/lease was acquired. Non-reusable evidence observed earlier is stale.

LeaseExpiresAt.description: Optional. When the current lease expires. Requires EvaluatedAt; evaluation or evidence at or after expiry is stale.

EvaluatedAt.description: Optional. Host-supplied evaluation instant. Dokimos never reads the clock, so receipts stay deterministic.

TrustedVerifierKeys.description: Optional. Verifier keys whose signed receipts the host trusts. A non-empty list selects attested mode; absent or empty keeps 0.6.0 behaviour.

KeyId.description: sha256: + hex SHA-256 of the SubjectPublicKeyInfo DER; must match PublicKey.

PublicKey.description: Base64 SubjectPublicKeyInfo DER of an ECDSA P-256 key.

ValidationPolicyDigest.description: Optional. sha256: digest of the host-owned echelon.validation-policy/1 file that every attested receipt must bind.

dsseEnvelope.description: DSSE v1 envelope: payloadType, base64 payload and signatures [{ keyid, sig }] (ECDSA P-256 / SHA-256, IEEE P1363 r||s, over the DSSE PAE).
